**Issue #3567 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3567: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S19, the legends and rule benders
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the set's legends and rule benders: Profe Yates, Churnwalker, Snom Bunny, Soul Read, Bogos Binted and Doomed Ship.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #4 | Profe Yates |
| #7 | Churnwalker |
| #25 | Snom Bunny |
| #31 | Soul Read |
| #84 | Bogos Binted |
| #98 | Doomed Ship |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E6 (#3550): the secret pick, take control, the board snapshot.
- E7 (#3554): damage chains.
- E8 (#3558): hand positions and "when they meet".

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #4 Profe Yates: the exile hits every card in both hands, decks, graveyards and fields whose name holds any of M, O, U, S, E (any case), except CN cards and Yates itself. The two random Traps (Radiant: three Radiant Traps) are summoned face down into its owner's backrow. Its owner then chooses one of the three Activates, which Yates keeps. Wolf's Maw: the Flying Unit loses Flying and takes 4. Iron Mandate fuses Yates into a friendly Unit without running its Cry again. The voice lines are S26's.
- #7 Churnwalker: damage chains as E7 reads them. The Radiant face's Cry is the same choice (SP5).
- #25 Snom Bunny: a new card, not the shipped Snom Bunny Mind Control. Its Death takes control of a random enemy permanent (E6).
- #31 Soul Read: E6's secret pick. Only its owner ever sees the opponent's hand, and only during the pick.
- #84 Bogos Binted: E6's snapshot and restore.
- #98 Doomed Ship: one of the three pairs at random. "Kwzki" is iKwzki (S #110). The first card goes leftmost and the second rightmost, and when they meet (become adjacent) both become Radiant (Radiant face: and cost (0)).

## The designer's text, verbatim

- Activate 3: Wolf’s Maw: Pull a flying unit down *{it loses flying}*, and deal 4 damage to it
- Activate 1: Iron Mandate: Fuse this into a unit, *{does not trigger this cry again}*

*{Spawn voiceline: Every pack needs an alpha I don't see anyone else stepping up}*
*{Attack voiceline: a mouse once bit my sister}*
*{Death voiceline: I will not see the Northern Lights again}*

- Activate 3: Wolf’s Maw: Pull a flying unit down *{it loses flying}*, and deal 4 damage to it
- Activate 1: Iron Mandate: Fuse this into a unit, *{does not trigger this cry again}*

Add a **Kwzki** and **Shockwave447**, **Shadiris** and **xxFreshJack**, or **Tylannt** and **Siva 1** to the left and right most cards of your hand. When they meet both become Radiant and cost (0).

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3558

Part of #3534.
````
